articles.title: Australia's Sarytogan Graphite publishes first DFS of two planned for Sarytogan project

The company plans to have 20 000 t/y classified into three sizes up 15 microns for drilling fluids, lubricants and friction products, 10 000 t/y of unclassified concentrate for the foundry and iron recarburiser market and 20 000 t/y for a planned downstream graphite business to make ultrahigh-purity fines and coated spherical purified graphite products.
